Maria K: Quick mid-quarter pulse — can teams confirm milestone status for the OKR: 'Serving cost reduction' (what shipped, what slipped, owners, blockers). Keep it to 1-2 lines per item please. I'll collate by EOD.
Alex P: Shipped: routing canary + perf dashboard. Owner: @Alex P. Note: small perf regression on 512-token tails, tracking in #eng-runtime.
Jordan L: Slipped: quantization audit (int8 validation). Owner: @Jordan L. Blocker: no dedicated int8 benchmark infra yet. PRs open: #412, #415. ETA ~2w.
Priya S: Shipped: embedding-upsert API v1 (stable). Owner: @Priya S. Next: alerting for rate-limit spikes.
Samir R: Need review on infra/autoscaler PR (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/88) — @Lee T can you take a look? cc @Alex P
Lee T: On it, will review today. FYI autoscaler needs a small schema tweak for reserved pools.
Maria K: Thanks — can owners add a "Next action" + ETA line? e.g. "Next: infra review -> ETA 48h"
Alex P: Next: triage perf regression (logs + ablation). ETA 3 days. Owner: @Alex P.
Jordan L: Next: provision int8 benchmarking infra + run baseline. ETA 10 business days. Owner: @Jordan L. Blocker: capacity quota request submitted to @Samir R.
Samir R: Acknowledged quota request, coordinating with cloud team — ETA 3 business days.
Priya S: Note: embedding-upsert rate-limit alert is noisy during bursts; adding metric filter & pager tweak tonight.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for routing-v2 on blue cluster — https://deploys.redwood/1234 :rocket:
Maria K: OK I'll collate these into the milestone doc (https://docs.redwood/okr/milestones) and flag any cross-team deps. Anyone else with slips or open deps?
Lee T: One more: security scan flagged an S3 ACL warning for private deploy package. Owner: @Lee T. Next: apply ACL fix -> ETA 24h.
Maria K: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll post consolidated update and owner checklist by EOD. If anything changes, update this thread.
